description: List the EPA programs unified in this dataset (Clean Air Act, Clean Water Act/NPDES, Safe Drinking Water Act, RCRA hazardous waste, Toxics Release Inventory, Greenhouse Gas Reporting) with what each covers, how many facilities belong to each, and how many of those facilities are currently in violation. Facility and violation counts reflect the current monthly ECHO Exporter snapshot — see the API status for the exact data vintage.
name: list_programs
